title: Nuxe strengthens sales and marketing leadership to drive global growth
summary: Following the appointment of Christine Delfaut Sara as CEO, Nuxe is continuing to strengthen its organization with three strategic appointments. Already present in more than 60 countries, the French pioneer of natural skin and body care products aims to give fresh momentum to its growth ambitions in both domestic and international markets. Claire Desaleux joins as Director of Sales Excellence, Maxime de La Baume as National Account Director, and Charlotte Guerpillon as Brand Director.... - Industry buzz
